stem: Which detail from the selection supports the idea that people enjoy watching the Puppy Bowl?

options.label: A
options.text: Animals are filmed months before the Super Bowl takes place.

options.label: B
options.text: The Puppy Bowl is seen by as many as 12.4 million viewers every year.

options.label: C
options.text: Animal shelters throughout the country send pictures of animals.

options.label: D
options.text: The Puppy Bowl can be seen on the same day as the Super Bowl.
